groups.name: The Gentlemen
groups.profile: Emerged mid-2025; reported to deploy its locker domain-wide via Group Policy and to target mid-size firms across many sectors. Today: a batch of 12 names posted 20:12–21:36 UTC, all RansomLook-only with no country tags.

groups.name: SafePay
groups.profile: Active since late 2024, no affiliate program; known for fast VPN/RDP intrusions with stolen credentials. Today: a batch of 9 domain-named victims posted around 10:16–11:23 UTC.
groups.countries: Germany, Philippines, Romania, Spain, Thailand, United Kingdom, United States
groups.sectors: Agriculture and Food Production, Manufacturing, Professional Services, Retail & E-Commerce, not disclosed

groups.name: Qilin
groups.profile: Prolific RaaS (aka Agenda) since 2022; Rust/Go lockers, VMware ESXi targeting, double extortion; among the most active groups of 2025–26.

groups.name: Space Bears
groups.profile: Data-extortion brand seen since 2024, with corporate-style leak pages; reported links to the Phobos ecosystem. Four names were posted together around 03:16–04:44 UTC.

groups.name: Aurora
groups.profile: Newer leak site posting long, sector-tagged write-ups with redacted item lists (“The exposed material includes…”).

groups.name: Aoqin Leaks
groups.profile: Aoqin / Aoqin Leaks: little-documented leak site; today it posted a US moving company and a US imaging practice. The two feeds use different names for it, merged here.

groups.name: Insomnia
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site. Both of today’s names are linked Connecticut municipal bodies, posted at 14:16 UTC, RansomLook-only.

groups.name: Rhysida
groups.profile: RaaS since May 2023 (subject of CISA advisory AA23-319A); hits healthcare, education, government and legal; publishes large file inventories, as with both of today’s listings.

groups.name: Dark Project
groups.profile: Leak site posting boilerplate “fell victim to a cyberattack” notices with volume claims.

groups.name: Eclipse
groups.profile: Small leak site seen in recent issues, posting US mid-market firms with long company profiles.

groups.name: Everstake
groups.profile: Little-documented leak site; its listings carry only a sector line.

groups.name: Falcon
groups.profile: It posts large exfiltration claims without encryption; RedPacket Security notes its claims are unverified.

groups.name: INC Ransom
groups.profile: INC Ransom, active since mid-2023; spear-phishing and exploitation of Citrix/FortiGate edge devices; heavy US healthcare and manufacturing focus.

groups.name: LockBit 5.0
groups.profile: LockBit 5.0 is the relaunched LockBit brand after the 2024 Operation Cronos disruption; affiliate model, broad targeting.

groups.name: MedusaLocker
groups.profile: Long-running RaaS (since 2019) relying on exposed RDP and phishing.

groups.name: Osiris
groups.profile: Leak site using countdown timers with revenue and headcount metadata; today’s listing publishes on 30 Nov.

groups.name: PixelLeaks
groups.profile: Posts descriptive, often unnamed targets with publication deadlines and itemised record lists. Today it named an Iranian compressor maker.

groups.name: Whitearmor
groups.profile: Small leak site focused on Latin American healthcare; today a “full release” of five Colombian clinic databases.
